key.name: panel-provider
key.summary: Provider shown in the top bar
key.description: 'auto' picks the first enabled provider with data; otherwise a provider id such as 'claude' or 'codex'.

key.name: panel-window
key.summary: Usage window shown in the top bar
key.description: 'headline' shows whichever window is closest to its limit.

key.name: show-icon
key.summary: Show the icon in the top bar

key.name: show-percent
key.summary: Show the percentage in the top bar

key.name: show-countdown
key.summary: Show the time until reset in the top bar

key.name: show-bar
key.summary: Show a small usage bar in the top bar

key.name: warn-threshold
key.summary: Usage percentage that turns the label amber

key.name: critical-threshold
key.summary: Usage percentage that turns the label red

key.name: panel-position
key.summary: Top bar area that holds the indicator

key.name: panel-index
key.summary: Position within the top bar area
